g.text: A36 and A37 each pass 2/5 original conditions: nonmatches decrease, but matching-pair and long-chain retention fail.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b626b

g.text: Grain is a TRAIN window–chain pair, not a unique gene. Unknown is not an error; known nonmatch is not biological false positive.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b626b

g.text: Training differs: A36 uses positive injection / 366,191 parameters; A37 is natural-only / 612,324. Descriptive, not causal.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b626b

g.text: Sources: A31 readout 13398521; A36 CPU 13408451; A37 CPU 13410742. A38 excluded. No raw-FASTA or generalization claim.
